system.name: Mass Charm Rev
system.description:
When this spell is cast, one or more creatures will imagine the caster to be their best friend, and treat them accordingly. It does not make them fanatically loyal and will not make them attack their other friends. Similarly, it does not create any romantic attachment and does not override consent.

If a target fails its spell save, then it gets another one periodically to throw off the charm effect. The frequency of the save is based on the creature's intelligence:

0 Intelligence = save every 120 days 1 Intelligence = save every 90 days 2 Intelligence = save every 60 days 3 Intelligence = save every 45 days 4–5 Intelligence = save every 30 days 6–8 Intelligence = save every 15 days 9–12 Intelligence = save every 7 days 13–15 Intelligence = save every 3 days 16–17 Intelligence = save every 24 hours 18 Intelligence = save every 8 hours 19 Intelligence = save every 3 hours 20 Intelligence = save every hour 21–29 Intelligence = save every 10 minutes 30+ Intelligence = save every round

If the caster does something to break the charm against one target, such as attacking it, then other targets who see the incident get an immediate save to break their charm too.

This spell works on any living creature, but not on undead or nonliving creatures such as automatons. The spell will affect a total of 30 hit dice or levels of creatures, and all targets get a spell save at a penalty of –2 to avoid the effect. Creatures who make the save still count towards the 30 hit dice limit.

Reverse: Remove Charm removes all charm effects in a 10' radius with no chance of failure, and also prevents any object or creature within that radius from being affected by charm effects for 10 minutes.
